overview: In the Signature teaching of 3d modeling basics, What 3D Modeling Basics Studies is a load-bearing idea: understand it and much of the field clicks into place. Mesh means the polygon surface of vertices, edges, faces Topology means clean quad flow for animation Together these ideas give the learner working intuition, not just vocabulary. The Signature presentation stresses why each principle holds, shows where it is used in real practice, and connects it forward to the Foundations material that follows.
core_concepts: Mesh: the polygon surface of vertices, edges, faces
Topology: clean quad flow for animation
key_laws: Learn navigation and basic transforms first.
methods: Model method: block the silhouette, refine forms, retopologize if needed
history: 3D modeling grew from 1970s CAD and 1990s film VFX; Blender’s free release in 2002 democratized the craft.
key_points: Mesh: the polygon surface of vertices, edges, faces
Topology: clean quad flow for animation
Key vocabulary: Vertex/edge/face — the mesh components; UV — the texture coordinates.
Governing principle: Learn navigation and basic transforms first.
